section_summary: This section covers correspondence, applications, and military clearances concerning travel to, from, and through occupied Japan in late 1948 and early 1949. Major topics include commercial entrant applications vetted by the Department of Commerce and SCAP, repatriation requests for foreign nationals and Japanese dependents, and urgent transit permits. Multiple records document strict SCAP regulations barring temporary visits for personal reasons and excluding applicants affiliated with wartime German enterprises.
